# Adding a file git already tracks warns: .gitignore does not untrack it, so
# its plaintext would keep being committed.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

exec git add -f tracked.env
exec git commit -m 'oops, plaintext'

exec sesam add tracked.env untracked.env
stderr 'tracked by git.*path=tracked.env'
! stderr 'path=untracked.env'

-- tracked.env --
TOKEN=1
-- untracked.env --
TOKEN=2
